beats.text: In Turkmenistan, 98.4% of adults finished high school. In Niger, it's just 1.7%.
The USA sits near the top, with 91.6% of adults completing high school.
Other major economies lag behind: India has 41.3%, while China has 31.8%.
Central Asia leads: Turkmenistan is at 98.4%, Uzbekistan 96.8%, and Kazakhstan 94.3%.
It counts the percentage of population ages 25 and over that attained or completed upper secondary education.
At the bottom, Senegal has 8.4% and Mali has 7.2%.
